item.title: Mastercard agrees to acquire BVNK, a stablecoin-payments infrastructure firm, for up to $1.8 billion.
Morgan Stanley receives preliminary OCC approval to launch a national trust bank for digital asset custody and staking.
JPMorgan plans to accept Bitcoin as loan collateral following passage of the GENIUS Act.
U.S. Senate moves toward Clarity Act vote within two weeks; new draft adds restrictions on officials issuing crypto tokens.
SEC schedules three July crypto rule proposals covering token offerings, broker-dealer custody, and digital asset trading venues.
Japan amends financial laws to reclassify cryptocurrencies as investment assets, replacing the prior payments-focused framework.
Three DeFi bridges and cross-chain protocols lost a combined $35 million in coordinated bridge and oracle attacks on July 23.
Ostium loses $18 million after attacker manipulates the protocol's own oracle infrastructure to generate false trading profits.
EU regulators begin rewriting MiCA after the July 1 enforcement deadline, with the stablecoin interest-yield ban under review.
DTCC opens a July pilot for a tokenized securities settlement platform built with BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, and JPMorgan.
CFTC's three-month trial period for regulated 24/7 bitcoin perpetual futures ends July 27, closing the initial approval window.
Ripple's crypto asset service provider license in Luxembourg is upgraded to fully MiCA-compliant status.
Europe's MiCA compliance costs are pushing smaller crypto firms toward mergers and closer bank partnerships.
DeFi protocol Summer.fi pauses Lazy Summer yield vaults after a $6 million exploit targeting its smart contracts.
